newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan finance minister to leave for G7 on Sept 28.
newsitem.headline: Japan finance minister to leave for G7 on Sept 28.

text.p: Japan's Finance Minister Wataru Kubo will leave Tokyo for Washington on Saturday to attend a meeting of Group of Seven (G7) finance ministers and central bankers and the annual meeting of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank, the ministry said on Friday.
Kubo will return to Tokyo on October 2.
He will visit New York on Monday to make a speech to an organisation called the Japan Society, ministry officials said.
